dialogue.text: Let's keep it warm!
dialogue.zh: 讓我們保持溫暖！
dialogue.ja: 暖かくしていよう！
dialogue.local: Let's keep it warm!
dialogue.en: Let's keep it warm!

dialogue.text: You totally should retract!
dialogue.zh: 你完全應該收回！
dialogue.ja: 絶対に引っ込むべきだ！
dialogue.local: You totally should retract!
dialogue.en: You totally should retract!

dialogue.text: I know the
dialogue.zh: 我知道這個
dialogue.ja: 私はそれを知っている
dialogue.local: I know the
dialogue.en: I know the

dialogue.text: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural
dialogue.zh: 兩千多年前，古代中國學者觀察了我們自然界中變化的模式
dialogue.ja: 2000年以上前、古代の中国の学者たちは自然界の変化するパターンを観察しました
dialogue.local: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural
dialogue.en: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural

dialogue.text: world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
dialogue.zh: 世界、氣候、季節的更替和天文現象。
dialogue.ja: 世界、気候、季節の移り変わり、そして天文学を。
dialogue.local: world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
dialogue.en: world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.

dialogue.text: This scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-4 paths, creating
dialogue.zh: 這些學者測量並將太陽的年度運動分為24條路徑，創造了
dialogue.ja: これらの学者は太陽の年間の動きを測定し、24の区分に分けて作り出しました
dialogue.local: This scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-4 paths, creating
dialogue.en: This scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-4 paths, creating

dialogue.text: the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
dialogue.zh: 24節氣，這些節氣用來管理古代中國的農業。
dialogue.ja: 24節気は、古代中国の農業を管理するために使われました。
dialogue.local: the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
dialogue.en: the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.

dialogue.text: Even to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions
dialogue.zh: 直到今天，這項發明仍指引著數億中國人的生活和傳統。
dialogue.ja: 今日に至るまで、この発明は数億人の中国人の生活と伝統を導いています。
dialogue.local: Even to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions
dialogue.en: Even to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions

dialogue.text: of Chinese people.
dialogue.zh: 中國人的生活。
dialogue.ja: 中国人の生活です。
dialogue.local: of Chinese people.
dialogue.en: of Chinese people.

dialogue.text: Every year, around November 22, the light snow solar term comes.
dialogue.zh: 每年大約在11月22日，輕雪節氣到來。
dialogue.ja: 毎年11月22日頃に、軽い雪の節気が訪れます。
dialogue.local: Every year, around November 22, the light snow solar term comes.
dialogue.en: Every year, around November 22, the light snow solar term comes.

dialogue.text: Chinese farmers light snow.
dialogue.zh: 中國農民稱之為輕雪。
dialogue.ja: 中国の農民はこれを軽い雪と呼びます。
dialogue.local: Chinese farmers light snow.
dialogue.en: Chinese farmers light snow.

dialogue.text: Snow during the light snow season means a good harvest and abundant production in the following
dialogue.zh: 輕雪季節的雪象徵著來年豐收和豐富的產量。
dialogue.ja: 軽い雪の季節の雪は、翌年の豊作と豊かな生産を意味します。
dialogue.local: Snow during the light snow season means a good harvest and abundant production in the following
dialogue.en: Snow during the light snow season means a good harvest and abundant production in the following

dialogue.text: year.
dialogue.zh: 年。
dialogue.ja: 年です。
dialogue.local: year.
dialogue.en: year.

dialogue.text: In this snow is the crystallization of a thousand years of experience.
dialogue.zh: 這雪中凝結著千年的經驗結晶。
dialogue.ja: この雪には千年の経験の結晶が込められています。
dialogue.local: In this snow is the crystallization of a thousand years of experience.
dialogue.en: In this snow is the crystallization of a thousand years of experience.

dialogue.text: The light snow solar term has arrived, northern China may have been frozen solid for
dialogue.zh: 輕雪節氣已到，北方中國可能已經結冰很久了。
dialogue.ja: 軽い雪の節気が訪れ、北中国はすでに凍りついているかもしれません。
dialogue.local: The light snow solar term has arrived, northern China may have been frozen solid for
dialogue.en: The light snow solar term has arrived, northern China may have been frozen solid for

dialogue.text: a while now.
dialogue.zh: 一段時間了。
dialogue.ja: しばらくの間です。
dialogue.local: a while now.
dialogue.en: a while now.

dialogue.text: But right down at the southern edge of China, the rice has only just been harvested.
dialogue.zh: 但在中國南端，稻米才剛剛收割。
dialogue.ja: しかし、中国の南端では、稲がちょうど収穫されたばかりです。
dialogue.local: But right down at the southern edge of China, the rice has only just been harvested.
dialogue.en: But right down at the southern edge of China, the rice has only just been harvested.

dialogue.text: For one of China's oldest ethnic groups, known as the Miao, this is when they get to celebrate
dialogue.zh: 對中國最古老的民族之一——苗族來說，這是他們慶祝的時刻。
dialogue.ja: 中国の最も古い民族の一つ、苗族にとっては、これが祝う時です。
dialogue.local: For one of China's oldest ethnic groups, known as the Miao, this is when they get to celebrate
dialogue.en: For one of China's oldest ethnic groups, known as the Miao, this is when they get to celebrate

dialogue.text: New Year.
dialogue.zh: 新年。
dialogue.ja: 新年です。
dialogue.local: New Year.
dialogue.en: New Year.

dialogue.text: It's the light snow season for some, but it's party time for the Miao.
dialogue.zh: 對某些人來說是輕雪季節，但對苗族來說是派對時間。
dialogue.ja: 一部の人にとっては軽い雪の季節ですが、苗族にとってはお祭りの時間です。
dialogue.local: It's the light snow season for some, but it's party time for the Miao.
dialogue.en: It's the light snow season for some, but it's party time for the Miao.

dialogue.text: 56 state recognized ethnic groups live in China.
dialogue.zh: 中國有56個國家認可的民族。
dialogue.ja: 中国には56の国家承認された民族がいます。
dialogue.local: 56 state recognized ethnic groups live in China.
dialogue.en: 56 state recognized ethnic groups live in China.

dialogue.text: Each group has its own unique traditions.
dialogue.zh: 每個民族都有自己獨特的傳統。
dialogue.ja: それぞれの民族には独自の伝統があります。
dialogue.local: Each group has its own unique traditions.
dialogue.en: Each group has its own unique traditions.

dialogue.text: The Miao are the fourth largest group by population.
dialogue.zh: 苗族是人口第四大的民族。
dialogue.ja: 苗族は人口で4番目に大きい民族です。
dialogue.local: The Miao are the fourth largest group by population.
dialogue.en: The Miao are the fourth largest group by population.

dialogue.text: They have their own language, but it's never been written down.
dialogue.zh: 他們有自己的語言，但從未被書寫下來。
dialogue.ja: 彼らは独自の言語を持っていますが、書き記されたことはありません。
dialogue.local: They have their own language, but it's never been written down.
dialogue.en: They have their own language, but it's never been written down.

dialogue.text: The survival of their customs relies on stories past generation to generation at times
dialogue.zh: 他們的習俗存續依賴於代代相傳的故事，特別是在這樣的時刻。
dialogue.ja: 彼らの習慣の存続は、時に世代から世代へ伝えられる物語に依存しています。
dialogue.local: The survival of their customs relies on stories past generation to generation at times
dialogue.en: The survival of their customs relies on stories past generation to generation at times

dialogue.text: like this.
dialogue.zh: 就像這樣。
dialogue.ja: このような時に。
dialogue.local: like this.
dialogue.en: like this.

dialogue.text: This Miao village's rice crop has just been brought in.
dialogue.zh: 這個苗族村莊的稻米剛剛收割完。
dialogue.ja: この苗族の村の稲作はちょうど収穫されたばかりです。
dialogue.local: This Miao village's rice crop has just been brought in.
dialogue.en: This Miao village's rice crop has just been brought in.

dialogue.text: There's no one left hanging about in the fields.
dialogue.zh: 田裡已經沒有人逗留了。
dialogue.ja: 畑にはもう誰も残っていません。
dialogue.local: There's no one left hanging about in the fields.
dialogue.en: There's no one left hanging about in the fields.

dialogue.text: People are getting ready for the best moment of the year, when they can all go out and
dialogue.zh: 人們正在準備一年中最美好的時刻，大家可以一起外出
dialogue.ja: 人々は一年で最高の瞬間の準備をしています。みんなで出かけて
dialogue.local: People are getting ready for the best moment of the year, when they can all go out and
dialogue.en: People are getting ready for the best moment of the year, when they can all go out and

dialogue.text: celebrate the year's harvest.
dialogue.zh: 慶祝一年的豐收。
dialogue.ja: その年の収穫を祝います。
dialogue.local: celebrate the year's harvest.
dialogue.en: celebrate the year's harvest.

dialogue.text: This young village of Xiaofu fishes in the fields recently vacated by the rice.
dialogue.zh: 這個年輕的村莊小福在剛收割完的田裡捕魚。
dialogue.ja: 若い村のシャオフは、最近稲が刈り取られた田んぼで魚を釣っています。
dialogue.local: This young village of Xiaofu fishes in the fields recently vacated by the rice.
dialogue.en: This young village of Xiaofu fishes in the fields recently vacated by the rice.

dialogue.text: He's fishing for a kind of carp that has lived in the rice paddies since ancient times.
dialogue.zh: 他正在捕一種自古以來生活在稻田裡的鯉魚。
dialogue.ja: 彼は古くから稲田に生息するコイの一種を釣っています。
dialogue.local: He's fishing for a kind of carp that has lived in the rice paddies since ancient times.
dialogue.en: He's fishing for a kind of carp that has lived in the rice paddies since ancient times.

dialogue.text: The field fish, as it is known here, looks stunning, with bright colours, and it tastes
dialogue.zh: 這種被稱為田魚的魚色彩鮮豔，味道鮮美，
dialogue.ja: ここで田魚と呼ばれるその魚は鮮やかな色をしていて、とても美味しいです。
dialogue.local: The field fish, as it is known here, looks stunning, with bright colours, and it tastes
dialogue.en: The field fish, as it is known here, looks stunning, with bright colours, and it tastes

dialogue.text: delicious, even scales are soft enough to be eaten.
dialogue.zh: 甚至魚鱗都軟到可以食用。
dialogue.ja: 鱗も柔らかくて食べられます。
dialogue.local: delicious, even scales are soft enough to be eaten.
dialogue.en: delicious, even scales are soft enough to be eaten.

dialogue.text: It may be much warmer than in the north, but the water temperature is still pretty chilly
dialogue.zh: 這裡可能比北方暖和很多，但水溫仍然相當寒冷，
dialogue.ja: 北よりはずっと暖かいかもしれませんが、水温はまだかなり冷たいです。
dialogue.local: It may be much warmer than in the north, but the water temperature is still pretty chilly
dialogue.en: It may be much warmer than in the north, but the water temperature is still pretty chilly

dialogue.text: at around five degrees Celsius.
dialogue.zh: 大約攝氏五度左右。
dialogue.ja: 約5度くらいです。
dialogue.local: at around five degrees Celsius.
dialogue.en: at around five degrees Celsius.

dialogue.text: China was the first country in the world to breed fresh waterfish.
dialogue.zh: 中國是世界上第一個養殖淡水魚的國家。
dialogue.ja: 中国は世界で最初に淡水魚の養殖を始めた国です。
dialogue.local: China was the first country in the world to breed fresh waterfish.
dialogue.en: China was the first country in the world to breed fresh waterfish.

dialogue.text: As early as 3,000 years ago, the Chinese began raising fish and ponds.
dialogue.zh: 早在三千年前，中國人就開始在池塘養魚。
dialogue.ja: 3000年前には、中国人は池で魚を飼い始めていました。
dialogue.local: As early as 3,000 years ago, the Chinese began raising fish and ponds.
dialogue.en: As early as 3,000 years ago, the Chinese began raising fish and ponds.

dialogue.text: Using the rice fields to keep them captive, these fish have kept pests and weeds to
dialogue.zh: 利用稻田來圈養魚，這些魚幫助控制害蟲和雜草，
dialogue.ja: 稲田を利用して魚を飼い、害虫や雑草を抑えてきました。
dialogue.local: Using the rice fields to keep them captive, these fish have kept pests and weeds to
dialogue.en: Using the rice fields to keep them captive, these fish have kept pests and weeds to

dialogue.text: a minimum for 2,000 years.
dialogue.zh: 兩千年來將害蟲和雜草控制在最低限度。
dialogue.ja: 2000年間、害虫や雑草を最小限に抑えてきました。
dialogue.local: a minimum for 2,000 years.
dialogue.en: a minimum for 2,000 years.

dialogue.text: Caminior has enriched the soil too.
dialogue.zh: 魚糞也使土壤更加肥沃。
dialogue.ja: 魚の排泄物は土壌も豊かにしました。
dialogue.local: Caminior has enriched the soil too.
dialogue.en: Caminior has enriched the soil too.

dialogue.text: This is how to max out your rice fields.
dialogue.zh: 這就是如何最大化利用你的稻田。
dialogue.ja: これが稲田を最大限に活用する方法です。
dialogue.local: This is how to max out your rice fields.
dialogue.en: This is how to max out your rice fields.

dialogue.text: Plus, you get to eat the fish after.
dialogue.zh: 而且你還可以吃這些魚。
dialogue.ja: さらに、その後に魚を食べることもできます。
dialogue.local: Plus, you get to eat the fish after.
dialogue.en: Plus, you get to eat the fish after.

dialogue.text: Xiaofu has just caught himself a tasty New Year's Eve dinner.
dialogue.zh: 小福剛剛捕到了一頓美味的除夕晚餐。
dialogue.ja: シャオフはちょうど美味しい大晦日の夕食を捕まえました。
dialogue.local: Xiaofu has just caught himself a tasty New Year's Eve dinner.
dialogue.en: Xiaofu has just caught himself a tasty New Year's Eve dinner.

dialogue.text: While Xiaofu fishes out in the paddies, his mother gets preparing to hit the town.
dialogue.zh: 當小福在田裡捕魚時，他的母親正在準備去城裡。
dialogue.ja: シャオフが田んぼで魚を釣っている間に、彼の母親は街に出かける準備をしています。
dialogue.local: While Xiaofu fishes out in the paddies, his mother gets preparing to hit the town.
dialogue.en: While Xiaofu fishes out in the paddies, his mother gets preparing to hit the town.

dialogue.text: Buying everything else for the New Year's Eve meal is a job for mum.
dialogue.zh: 買除夕晚餐的其他東西是媽媽的工作。
dialogue.ja: 大晦日の食事のための他のすべての買い物は母親の仕事です。
dialogue.local: Buying everything else for the New Year's Eve meal is a job for mum.
dialogue.en: Buying everything else for the New Year's Eve meal is a job for mum.

dialogue.text: The male people have been farmers forever.
dialogue.zh: 男性一直以來都是農民。
dialogue.ja: 男性はずっと農民でした。
dialogue.local: The male people have been farmers forever.
dialogue.en: The male people have been farmers forever.

dialogue.text: As early as 6,000 years ago, they mastered the use of a special ingredient, the chilly
dialogue.zh: 早在六千年前，他們就掌握了一種特殊的食材，辣椒。
dialogue.ja: 6000年前には、彼らは特別な食材、唐辛子の使い方を習得していました。
dialogue.local: As early as 6,000 years ago, they mastered the use of a special ingredient, the chilly
dialogue.en: As early as 6,000 years ago, they mastered the use of a special ingredient, the chilly

dialogue.text: weekend, absolutely everything has been doused in them.
dialogue.zh: 週末，幾乎所有東西都被辣椒淋上。
dialogue.ja: 週末には、ほとんどすべてのものに唐辛子が使われています。
dialogue.local: weekend, absolutely everything has been doused in them.
dialogue.en: weekend, absolutely everything has been doused in them.

dialogue.text: The light snow season sees the temperature drop sharply.
dialogue.zh: 輕雪季節氣溫急劇下降。
dialogue.ja: 軽い雪の季節には気温が急激に下がります。
dialogue.local: The light snow season sees the temperature drop sharply.
dialogue.en: The light snow season sees the temperature drop sharply.

dialogue.text: The air turns crisp and dry.
dialogue.zh: 空氣變得清爽乾燥。
dialogue.ja: 空気はさわやかで乾燥します。
dialogue.local: The air turns crisp and dry.
dialogue.en: The air turns crisp and dry.

dialogue.text: In the Chinese countryside, people wait for the light snow season to force starting to make
dialogue.zh: 在中國鄉村，人們等待輕雪季節開始製作
dialogue.ja: 中国の田舎では、人々は軽い雪の季節を待って作り始めます。
dialogue.local: In the Chinese countryside, people wait for the light snow season to force starting to make
dialogue.en: In the Chinese countryside, people wait for the light snow season to force starting to make

dialogue.text: homemade sausages and smoke bacon.
dialogue.zh: 自製香腸和煙燻培根。
dialogue.ja: 自家製のソーセージやベーコンの燻製を。
dialogue.local: homemade sausages and smoke bacon.
dialogue.en: homemade sausages and smoke bacon.

dialogue.text: Pork dunked in sauteed pepper and salt, marinated for half a month.
dialogue.zh: 豬肉浸泡在炒過的胡椒和鹽中，醃製半個月。
dialogue.ja: 豚肉を炒めた胡椒と塩に浸し、半月間漬け込みます。
dialogue.local: Pork dunked in sauteed pepper and salt, marinated for half a month.
dialogue.en: Pork dunked in sauteed pepper and salt, marinated for half a month.

dialogue.text: Hung from the beans, smoked from underneath by cypress twigs.
dialogue.zh: 掛在豆莢上，用柏樹枝從下方煙燻。
dialogue.ja: 豆のさやに吊るし、ヒノキの小枝で下から燻します。
dialogue.local: Hung from the beans, smoked from underneath by cypress twigs.
dialogue.en: Hung from the beans, smoked from underneath by cypress twigs.

dialogue.text: You have to make sure that the smoke is evenly spread.
dialogue.zh: 你必須確保煙霧均勻分布。
dialogue.ja: 煙が均一に広がるようにしなければなりません。
dialogue.local: You have to make sure that the smoke is evenly spread.
dialogue.en: You have to make sure that the smoke is evenly spread.

dialogue.text: The goal is for it to go dark red, then you know the flavour will have really sunk in.
dialogue.zh: 目標是讓它變成深紅色，這樣你就知道味道已經完全滲入。
dialogue.ja: 目標は濃い赤色になることで、そうすれば味がしっかり染み込んだことがわかります。
dialogue.local: The goal is for it to go dark red, then you know the flavour will have really sunk in.
dialogue.en: The goal is for it to go dark red, then you know the flavour will have really sunk in.

dialogue.text: Chinese people have always smoked meat to preserve it.
dialogue.zh: 中國人一直用煙燻肉類來保存食物。
dialogue.ja: 中国人は昔から肉を燻製にして保存してきました。
dialogue.local: Chinese people have always smoked meat to preserve it.
dialogue.en: Chinese people have always smoked meat to preserve it.

dialogue.text: More than 2,500 years ago, it's Confucius even accepted bacon for lessons.
dialogue.zh: 2500多年前，孔子甚至接受培根作為課程的酬勞。
dialogue.ja: 2500年以上前、孔子は授業の代わりにベーコンを受け取っていました。
dialogue.local: More than 2,500 years ago, it's Confucius even accepted bacon for lessons.
dialogue.en: More than 2,500 years ago, it's Confucius even accepted bacon for lessons.

dialogue.text: Send me 10 strips of smoked bacon and I will teach you, he said, so his students did
dialogue.zh: 他說：給我十條煙燻培根，我就教你們，所以學生們照做了。
dialogue.ja: 「燻製ベーコンを10枚送ってくれたら教えてやる」と彼は言い、生徒たちはそうしました。
dialogue.local: Send me 10 strips of smoked bacon and I will teach you, he said, so his students did
dialogue.en: Send me 10 strips of smoked bacon and I will teach you, he said, so his students did

dialogue.text: exactly that.
dialogue.zh: 正是如此。
dialogue.ja: まさにそうしました。
dialogue.local: exactly that.
dialogue.en: exactly that.

dialogue.text: It's the eve of the Miao's New Year, never mind those gurgling stomachs, making an offering
dialogue.zh: 這是苗族新年的前夕，先不管咕嚕叫的肚子，先祭祖。
dialogue.ja: 苗族の新年の前夜です。お腹の鳴る音は気にせず、まずは先祖に供え物をします。
dialogue.local: It's the eve of the Miao's New Year, never mind those gurgling stomachs, making an offering
dialogue.en: It's the eve of the Miao's New Year, never mind those gurgling stomachs, making an offering

dialogue.text: to the ancestors is on top of the list.
dialogue.zh: 祭拜祖先是最重要的。
dialogue.ja: 先祖への供え物が最優先です。
dialogue.local: to the ancestors is on top of the list.
dialogue.en: to the ancestors is on top of the list.

dialogue.text: They thank the clan for their blessings, the good fortune that has helped them bring in
dialogue.zh: 他們感謝氏族的祝福，感謝帶來豐收的好運。
dialogue.ja: 彼らは一族の祝福に感謝し、豊作をもたらした幸運に感謝します。
dialogue.local: They thank the clan for their blessings, the good fortune that has helped them bring in
dialogue.en: They thank the clan for their blessings, the good fortune that has helped them bring in

dialogue.text: a decent harvest.
dialogue.zh: 豐收。
dialogue.ja: 立派な収穫です。
dialogue.local: a decent harvest.
dialogue.en: a decent harvest.

dialogue.text: The New Year's Eve is a feast for the family and tomorrow's Miao Festival is
dialogue.zh: 除夕是家人的盛宴，明天的苗族節日是
dialogue.ja: 大晦日は家族の宴であり、明日の苗族の祭りは
dialogue.local: The New Year's Eve is a feast for the family and tomorrow's Miao Festival is
dialogue.en: The New Year's Eve is a feast for the family and tomorrow's Miao Festival is

dialogue.text: a coming together of the whole clan.
dialogue.zh: 整個氏族的聚會。
dialogue.ja: 一族全体の集まりです。
dialogue.local: a coming together of the whole clan.
dialogue.en: a coming together of the whole clan.

dialogue.text: The relation and character in Guido province is one of the main settlements of the Miao
dialogue.zh: 貴州省的關係和特性是苗族的主要聚居地之一。
dialogue.ja: 貴州省の関係と特徴は苗族の主要な居住地の一つです。
dialogue.local: The relation and character in Guido province is one of the main settlements of the Miao
dialogue.en: The relation and character in Guido province is one of the main settlements of the Miao

dialogue.text: people.
dialogue.zh: 人民。
dialogue.ja: 人々です。
dialogue.local: people.
dialogue.en: people.

dialogue.text: Traditions at New Year have been passed down for thousands of years, strange and magnificent.
dialogue.zh: 新年的傳統已流傳千年，既奇特又壯麗。
dialogue.ja: 新年の伝統は何千年も受け継がれており、不思議で壮大です。
dialogue.local: Traditions at New Year have been passed down for thousands of years, strange and magnificent.
dialogue.en: Traditions at New Year have been passed down for thousands of years, strange and magnificent.

dialogue.text: Beautiful girls wearing silver horns are filling the square, attracting everyone's attention.
dialogue.zh: 戴著銀角的美麗女孩們聚集在廣場，吸引了所有人的目光。
dialogue.ja: 銀の角をつけた美しい少女たちが広場を埋め尽くし、みんなの注目を集めています。
dialogue.local: Beautiful girls wearing silver horns are filling the square, attracting everyone's attention.
dialogue.en: Beautiful girls wearing silver horns are filling the square, attracting everyone's attention.

dialogue.text: Other ornaments are 100% essential for the new year.
dialogue.zh: 其他飾品對新年來說是必不可少的。
dialogue.ja: 他の装飾品も新年には欠かせません。
dialogue.local: Other ornaments are 100% essential for the new year.
dialogue.en: Other ornaments are 100% essential for the new year.

dialogue.text: A Miao girl here can wear anything from 10 to 15 kg of silver.
dialogue.zh: 這裡的苗族女孩可以佩戴10到15公斤的銀飾。
dialogue.ja: ここにいる苗族の少女は10〜15キロの銀を身につけることができます。
dialogue.local: A Miao girl here can wear anything from 10 to 15 kg of silver.
dialogue.en: A Miao girl here can wear anything from 10 to 15 kg of silver.

dialogue.text: The way they see it, if a girl does not have a set of silver jewelry, she can't even
dialogue.zh: 他們認為，如果女孩沒有一套銀飾，她甚至不能
dialogue.ja: 彼らの考えでは、少女が銀の装飾品を持っていなければ、結婚すら考えられません。
dialogue.local: The way they see it, if a girl does not have a set of silver jewelry, she can't even
dialogue.en: The way they see it, if a girl does not have a set of silver jewelry, she can't even

dialogue.text: consider getting married.
dialogue.zh: 考慮結婚。
dialogue.ja: 結婚を考えることもできません。
dialogue.local: consider getting married.
dialogue.en: consider getting married.

dialogue.text: If a young man doesn't know how to craft silver, he has no way to make it in Leshan.
dialogue.zh: 如果年輕人不會製作銀飾，他在樂山就無法成功。
dialogue.ja: 若い男性が銀細工を知らなければ、楽山で成功することはできません。
dialogue.local: If a young man doesn't know how to craft silver, he has no way to make it in Leshan.
dialogue.en: If a young man doesn't know how to craft silver, he has no way to make it in Leshan.

dialogue.text: The locals tell me these extremely delicate patterns are all handcrafted by Miao Silversmiths.
dialogue.zh: 當地人告訴我，這些極其精緻的圖案都是苗族銀匠手工製作的。
dialogue.ja: 地元の人は、これらの非常に繊細な模様はすべて苗族の銀細工師が手作りしていると言います。
dialogue.local: The locals tell me these extremely delicate patterns are all handcrafted by Miao Silversmiths.
dialogue.en: The locals tell me these extremely delicate patterns are all handcrafted by Miao Silversmiths.

dialogue.text: Siao whose father Long Thayo is a Miao Silversmith.
dialogue.zh: 小福的父親龍泰耀是苗族銀匠。
dialogue.ja: シャオの父親ロン・タイヨウは苗族の銀細工師です。
dialogue.local: Siao whose father Long Thayo is a Miao Silversmith.
dialogue.en: Siao whose father Long Thayo is a Miao Silversmith.

dialogue.text: Every year, during the light snow season, Miao farmers have little to do, but for Long
dialogue.zh: 每年輕雪季節，苗族農民沒什麼事做，但對龍泰耀來說，這是最忙的時候。
dialogue.ja: 毎年、軽い雪の季節には苗族の農民はあまり忙しくありませんが、ロン・タイヨウにとっては最も忙しい時期です。
dialogue.local: Every year, during the light snow season, Miao farmers have little to do, but for Long
dialogue.en: Every year, during the light snow season, Miao farmers have little to do, but for Long

dialogue.text: Thayo, this is absolutely the busiest time of year.
dialogue.zh: 對龍泰耀來說，這絕對是一年中最忙的時候。
dialogue.ja: ロン・タイヨウにとっては、これは間違いなく一年で最も忙しい時期です。
dialogue.local: Thayo, this is absolutely the busiest time of year.
dialogue.en: Thayo, this is absolutely the busiest time of year.

dialogue.text: People around the village rush to buy or repair their silver before getting decked out
dialogue.zh: 村裡的人們趕著買或修理銀飾，準備打扮一新
dialogue.ja: 村の人々は新年の装いのために銀製品を買ったり修理したり急いでいます。
dialogue.local: People around the village rush to buy or repair their silver before getting decked out
dialogue.en: People around the village rush to buy or repair their silver before getting decked out

dialogue.text: for the new year.
dialogue.zh: 迎接新年。
dialogue.ja: 新年のために。
dialogue.local: for the new year.
dialogue.en: for the new year.

dialogue.text: Making Quiligri is what Long Thayo does best.
dialogue.zh: 製作銀絲是龍泰耀最擅長的。
dialogue.ja: キリグリ作りはロン・タイヨウの得意分野です。
dialogue.local: Making Quiligri is what Long Thayo does best.
dialogue.en: Making Quiligri is what Long Thayo does best.

dialogue.text: It's one of the most basic steps, but also one of the hardest.
dialogue.zh: 這是最基本但也是最困難的步驟之一。
dialogue.ja: これは最も基本的な工程の一つであり、同時に最も難しいものの一つです。
dialogue.local: It's one of the most basic steps, but also one of the hardest.
dialogue.en: It's one of the most basic steps, but also one of the hardest.

dialogue.text: He has to turn bars of silver into silver string as fine as hair.
dialogue.zh: 他必須將銀條拉成像頭髮一樣細的銀絲。
dialogue.ja: 彼は銀の棒を髪の毛のように細い銀の糸に引き伸ばさなければなりません。
dialogue.local: He has to turn bars of silver into silver string as fine as hair.
dialogue.en: He has to turn bars of silver into silver string as fine as hair.

dialogue.text: This special silver drawing plate, 52 eyes of different diameters.
dialogue.zh: 這個特殊的銀拉絲板有52個不同直徑的孔。
dialogue.ja: この特別な銀の引き伸ばし板には、52個の異なる直径の穴があります。
dialogue.local: This special silver drawing plate, 52 eyes of different diameters.
dialogue.en: This special silver drawing plate, 52 eyes of different diameters.

dialogue.text: The silver strip must pass through all 52 in turn until it finally equals the diameter
dialogue.zh: 銀條必須依次通過所有52個孔，直到直徑等同於
dialogue.ja: 銀の細長い板は順番に52個すべての穴を通り、最終的に直径が
dialogue.local: The silver strip must pass through all 52 in turn until it finally equals the diameter
dialogue.en: The silver strip must pass through all 52 in turn until it finally equals the diameter

dialogue.text: of a human hair.
dialogue.zh: 一根頭髮的直徑。
dialogue.ja: 人間の髪の毛の直径になるまでです。
dialogue.local: of a human hair.
dialogue.en: of a human hair.

dialogue.text: Filigri making is a very traditional Chinese craft.
dialogue.zh: 銀絲工藝是非常傳統的中國手工藝。
dialogue.ja: フィリグリー作りは非常に伝統的な中国の工芸です。
dialogue.local: Filigri making is a very traditional Chinese craft.
dialogue.en: Filigri making is a very traditional Chinese craft.

dialogue.text: It's meticulous and needs a lot of patience.
dialogue.zh: 這工藝非常細緻，需要大量耐心。
dialogue.ja: これは細かくて忍耐が必要です。
dialogue.local: It's meticulous and needs a lot of patience.
dialogue.en: It's meticulous and needs a lot of patience.

dialogue.text: Found from silver as thin as silk thread.
dialogue.zh: 用像絲線一樣細的銀絲製作。
dialogue.ja: 絹糸のように細い銀から作られます。
dialogue.local: Found from silver as thin as silk thread.
dialogue.en: Found from silver as thin as silk thread.

dialogue.text: It is welded into place and turned into the most exquisite pieces of drawing.
dialogue.zh: 銀絲被焊接固定，變成最精緻的圖案。
dialogue.ja: それは溶接されて、最も精巧な模様に仕上げられます。
dialogue.local: It is welded into place and turned into the most exquisite pieces of drawing.
dialogue.en: It is welded into place and turned into the most exquisite pieces of drawing.

dialogue.text: Silver used to be China's hard currency.
dialogue.zh: 銀曾是中國的硬通貨。
dialogue.ja: 銀はかつて中国の硬貨でした。
dialogue.local: Silver used to be China's hard currency.
dialogue.en: Silver used to be China's hard currency.

dialogue.text: In the maritime era, westerners used to buy Chinese goods with silver, like fine porcelain
dialogue.zh: 在海洋時代，西方人用銀子購買中國商品，如精美瓷器，
dialogue.ja: 海洋時代には、西洋人は銀で中国の陶磁器などを買っていました。
dialogue.local: In the maritime era, westerners used to buy Chinese goods with silver, like fine porcelain
dialogue.en: In the maritime era, westerners used to buy Chinese goods with silver, like fine porcelain

dialogue.text: and silk and tea.
dialogue.zh: 絲綢和茶葉。
dialogue.ja: 絹やお茶もです。
dialogue.local: and silk and tea.
dialogue.en: and silk and tea.

dialogue.text: Europeans would travel the world looking for silver producing colonies and most of this
dialogue.zh: 歐洲人環遊世界尋找產銀殖民地，大部分銀子最終流入中國。
dialogue.ja: ヨーロッパ人は銀を産出する植民地を探して世界を旅し、その多くは中国に流れ込みました。
dialogue.local: Europeans would travel the world looking for silver producing colonies and most of this
dialogue.en: Europeans would travel the world looking for silver producing colonies and most of this

dialogue.text: silver would end up in China.
dialogue.zh: 銀最終流入中國。
dialogue.ja: 銀は最終的に中国に行き着きました。
dialogue.local: silver would end up in China.
dialogue.en: silver would end up in China.

dialogue.text: Out of all the Chinese, the Miao might be the people who are the most in love with silver.
dialogue.zh: 在所有中國人中，苗族可能是最愛銀的人。
dialogue.ja: 中国人の中で、苗族は銀を最も愛しているかもしれません。
dialogue.local: Out of all the Chinese, the Miao might be the people who are the most in love with silver.
dialogue.en: Out of all the Chinese, the Miao might be the people who are the most in love with silver.

dialogue.text: Their attraction to it goes way beyond its space value, as a cultural tradition that has
dialogue.zh: 他們對銀的熱愛遠超其價值，是一種傳承千年的文化傳統。
dialogue.ja: 彼らの銀への魅力は価値を超え、何千年も続く文化的伝統です。
dialogue.local: Their attraction to it goes way beyond its space value, as a cultural tradition that has
dialogue.en: Their attraction to it goes way beyond its space value, as a cultural tradition that has

dialogue.text: been passed down for thousands of years.
dialogue.zh: 這種傳統已經傳承了數千年。
dialogue.ja: 何千年も受け継がれてきました。
dialogue.local: been passed down for thousands of years.
dialogue.en: been passed down for thousands of years.

dialogue.text: This meant to bring luck and future good fortune.
dialogue.zh: 這象徵著帶來幸運和未來的好運。
dialogue.ja: これは幸運と未来の繁栄をもたらす意味があります。
dialogue.local: This meant to bring luck and future good fortune.
dialogue.en: This meant to bring luck and future good fortune.

dialogue.text: Here's an ocean of silver here.
dialogue.zh: 這裡是一片銀海。
dialogue.ja: ここには銀の海があります。
dialogue.local: Here's an ocean of silver here.
dialogue.en: Here's an ocean of silver here.

dialogue.text: This is the annual festival of the Miao people, the end of the old year, but most importantly
dialogue.zh: 這是苗族的年度節日，舊年的結束，但最重要的是
dialogue.ja: これは苗族の年に一度の祭りで、旧年の終わりですが、最も重要なのは
dialogue.local: This is the annual festival of the Miao people, the end of the old year, but most importantly
dialogue.en: This is the annual festival of the Miao people, the end of the old year, but most importantly

dialogue.text: the start of a new year.
dialogue.zh: 新年的開始。
dialogue.ja: 新年の始まりです。
dialogue.local: the start of a new year.
dialogue.en: the start of a new year.

dialogue.text: The Gumaas or the married daughters are back home with their families, for the most
dialogue.zh: 已婚女兒（稱為Gumaas）回家與家人團聚，參加最
dialogue.ja: グマアス、つまり既婚の娘たちは家族と共に帰省し、最も
dialogue.local: The Gumaas or the married daughters are back home with their families, for the most
dialogue.en: The Gumaas or the married daughters are back home with their families, for the most

dialogue.text: traditional and lively event of the Miao year.
dialogue.zh: 傳統且熱鬧的苗族年度盛事。
dialogue.ja: 伝統的で賑やかな苗族の年中行事に参加します。
dialogue.local: traditional and lively event of the Miao year.
dialogue.en: traditional and lively event of the Miao year.

dialogue.text: To be a Guma, you've got to be married.
dialogue.zh: 成為Guma，必須已婚。
dialogue.ja: グマになるには結婚していなければなりません。
dialogue.local: To be a Guma, you've got to be married.
dialogue.en: To be a Guma, you've got to be married.

dialogue.text: In the headwear, a Miao woman is wearing, you can tell if she's single or not.
dialogue.zh: 從苗族女性戴的頭飾可以看出她是否單身。
dialogue.ja: 苗族の女性が身につける頭飾で、独身かどうかがわかります。
dialogue.local: In the headwear, a Miao woman is wearing, you can tell if she's single or not.
dialogue.en: In the headwear, a Miao woman is wearing, you can tell if she's single or not.

dialogue.text: These girls with the silver horns on their heads are not married.
dialogue.zh: 頭戴銀角的女孩是未婚的。
dialogue.ja: 頭に銀の角をつけている少女たちは未婚です。
dialogue.local: These girls with the silver horns on their heads are not married.
dialogue.en: These girls with the silver horns on their heads are not married.

dialogue.text: Those without horns are the clan's married Gumaas.
dialogue.zh: 沒有角的是氏族中已婚的Gumaas。
dialogue.ja: 角のない女性は一族の既婚グマアスです。
dialogue.local: Those without horns are the clan's married Gumaas.
dialogue.en: Those without horns are the clan's married Gumaas.

dialogue.text: It used to be harder to travel, daughters who married far away could only meet up with
dialogue.zh: 以前交通不便，嫁得遠的女兒一年只能見母家一次。
dialogue.ja: 昔は移動が難しく、遠くに嫁いだ娘は母方の家族と年に一度しか会えませんでした。
dialogue.local: It used to be harder to travel, daughters who married far away could only meet up with
dialogue.en: It used to be harder to travel, daughters who married far away could only meet up with

dialogue.text: their mother's family once a year.
dialogue.zh: 母親家族一年見一次。
dialogue.ja: 母方の家族と年に一度会うだけでした。
dialogue.local: their mother's family once a year.
dialogue.en: their mother's family once a year.

dialogue.text: This may have changed a lot, but this tradition has turned into a big event.
dialogue.zh: 雖然現在改變很多，但這傳統已成為盛大活動。
dialogue.ja: 今は大きく変わったかもしれませんが、この伝統は大きなイベントになりました。
dialogue.local: This may have changed a lot, but this tradition has turned into a big event.
dialogue.en: This may have changed a lot, but this tradition has turned into a big event.

dialogue.text: At this time every year, thousands of Gumaas meet in the county square.
dialogue.zh: 每年此時，數千名Gumaas會在縣廣場聚會。
dialogue.ja: 毎年この時期に、何千ものグマアスが県の広場に集まります。
dialogue.local: At this time every year, thousands of Gumaas meet in the county square.
dialogue.en: At this time every year, thousands of Gumaas meet in the county square.

dialogue.text: They bring with them chicken, ducks and fish, plus gifts such as newly harvested rice
dialogue.zh: 他們帶來雞、鴨、魚和新收割的稻米等禮物，
dialogue.ja: 彼女たちは鶏、アヒル、魚、そして新しく収穫された米などの贈り物を持ってきます。
dialogue.local: They bring with them chicken, ducks and fish, plus gifts such as newly harvested rice
dialogue.en: They bring with them chicken, ducks and fish, plus gifts such as newly harvested rice

dialogue.text: and walk home together for New Year.
dialogue.zh: 一起回家過新年。
dialogue.ja: 一緒に家に帰って新年を祝います。
dialogue.local: and walk home together for New Year.
dialogue.en: and walk home together for New Year.

dialogue.text: People are saying that the Gumaas who lives the furthest away has to carry this much
dialogue.zh: 人們說住得最遠的Gumaas必須背負這麼多東西，
dialogue.ja: 最も遠くに住むグマアスはこれほどの荷物を運ばなければならないと言われています。
dialogue.local: People are saying that the Gumaas who lives the furthest away has to carry this much
dialogue.en: People are saying that the Gumaas who lives the furthest away has to carry this much

dialogue.text: weight for as far as 10 kilometers.
dialogue.zh: 長達10公里的路程。
dialogue.ja: 10キロメートルもの距離をです。
dialogue.local: weight for as far as 10 kilometers.
dialogue.en: weight for as far as 10 kilometers.

dialogue.text: While Gumaas are carrying gifts for their families, their husbands have to keep up the
dialogue.zh: 當Gumaas為家人帶禮物時，她們的丈夫則要維持
dialogue.ja: グマアスが家族への贈り物を運ぶ間、夫たちは
dialogue.local: While Gumaas are carrying gifts for their families, their husbands have to keep up the
dialogue.en: While Gumaas are carrying gifts for their families, their husbands have to keep up the

dialogue.text: temple, playing their read pipes, the length of the street.
dialogue.zh: 廟宇，沿街吹奏豎笛。
dialogue.ja: 寺院を守り、通り沿いでリードパイプを演奏します。
dialogue.local: temple, playing their read pipes, the length of the street.
dialogue.en: temple, playing their read pipes, the length of the street.

dialogue.text: This festival is in the hands of the women.
dialogue.zh: 這個節日由女性主導。
dialogue.ja: この祭りは女性たちの手に委ねられています。
dialogue.local: This festival is in the hands of the women.
dialogue.en: This festival is in the hands of the women.

dialogue.text: To welcome the Gumaas and their husbands back to the village for New Year are their family
dialogue.zh: 迎接Gumaas和她們的丈夫回村過新年的是留守的家人，
dialogue.ja: グマアスとその夫たちを村に迎えるのは、留守番をしている家族です。
dialogue.local: To welcome the Gumaas and their husbands back to the village for New Year are their family
dialogue.en: To welcome the Gumaas and their husbands back to the village for New Year are their family

dialogue.text: members who have stayed home and are super busy.
dialogue.zh: 他們非常忙碌。
dialogue.ja: 彼らはとても忙しいです。
dialogue.local: members who have stayed home and are super busy.
dialogue.en: members who have stayed home and are super busy.

dialogue.text: Steam is coming out of every kitchen.
dialogue.zh: 每個廚房都冒著蒸氣。
dialogue.ja: どの台所からも蒸気が立ち上っています。
dialogue.local: Steam is coming out of every kitchen.
dialogue.en: Steam is coming out of every kitchen.

dialogue.text: This year's glutinous rice has been well soaked in preparation.
dialogue.zh: 今年的糯米已經充分浸泡準備好了。
dialogue.ja: 今年のもち米は十分に浸されて準備ができています。
dialogue.local: This year's glutinous rice has been well soaked in preparation.
dialogue.en: This year's glutinous rice has been well soaked in preparation.

dialogue.text: It has come in the wooden steamers in which the glutinous rice will be cut before being
dialogue.zh: 它被放在木蒸籠中，糯米將在蒸熟後切割，
dialogue.ja: 木製の蒸し器に入れられ、もち米は蒸された後に切られます。
dialogue.local: It has come in the wooden steamers in which the glutinous rice will be cut before being
dialogue.en: It has come in the wooden steamers in which the glutinous rice will be cut before being

dialogue.text: bashed by hammers and turned into a miao speciality.
dialogue.zh: 用槌子敲打，變成苗族特色。
dialogue.ja: ハンマーで叩かれ、苗族の特産品になります。
dialogue.local: bashed by hammers and turned into a miao speciality.
dialogue.en: bashed by hammers and turned into a miao speciality.

dialogue.text: This is the bar, sticky sweet rice kicks.
dialogue.zh: 這是糯米甜糕。
dialogue.ja: これはもち米の甘いお菓子です。
dialogue.local: This is the bar, sticky sweet rice kicks.
dialogue.en: This is the bar, sticky sweet rice kicks.

dialogue.text: This tasty snack is made especially for the New Year and represents a good harvest at the
dialogue.zh: 這美味的小吃是專為新年製作，象徵輕雪節氣的豐收。
dialogue.ja: この美味しいお菓子は新年のために特別に作られ、軽い雪の季節の豊作を表しています。
dialogue.local: This tasty snack is made especially for the New Year and represents a good harvest at the
dialogue.en: This tasty snack is made especially for the New Year and represents a good harvest at the

dialogue.text: light snow season.
dialogue.zh: 輕雪節氣。
dialogue.ja: 軽い雪の季節です。
dialogue.local: light snow season.
dialogue.en: light snow season.

dialogue.text: It looks as though the Gumaas might be close by.
dialogue.zh: 看起來Gumaas可能快到了。
dialogue.ja: グマアスが近くにいるようです。
dialogue.local: It looks as though the Gumaas might be close by.
dialogue.en: It looks as though the Gumaas might be close by.

dialogue.text: The families run out and they man their drinking stations.
dialogue.zh: 家人們跑出來，守著他們的飲酒站。
dialogue.ja: 家族は外に出て、飲み物の場所を守ります。
dialogue.local: The families run out and they man their drinking stations.
dialogue.en: The families run out and they man their drinking stations.

dialogue.text: The homecomers must pass by 12 of these places and each one have one cup of rice wine.
dialogue.zh: 回家的人必須經過12個這樣的地方，每個地方喝一杯米酒。
dialogue.ja: 帰省者はこれらの場所を12か所通り、それぞれで一杯の米酒を飲みます。
dialogue.local: The homecomers must pass by 12 of these places and each one have one cup of rice wine.
dialogue.en: The homecomers must pass by 12 of these places and each one have one cup of rice wine.

dialogue.text: Only after downing all 12 falls can the Gumaas and their husbands each go to their own
dialogue.zh: 只有喝完12杯後，Gumaas和她們的丈夫才能各自回家。
dialogue.ja: 12杯すべてを飲み干して初めて、グマアスとその夫たちはそれぞれ自宅に帰れます。
dialogue.local: Only after downing all 12 falls can the Gumaas and their husbands each go to their own
dialogue.en: Only after downing all 12 falls can the Gumaas and their husbands each go to their own

dialogue.text: homes.
dialogue.zh: 家。
dialogue.ja: 家です。
dialogue.local: homes.
dialogue.en: homes.

dialogue.text: After drinking up rice wine, laid on the way as long as one kilo.
dialogue.zh: 喝完米酒後，路上放著長達一公斤的東西。
dialogue.ja: 米酒を飲み終えた後、道には1キロものものが置かれています。
dialogue.local: After drinking up rice wine, laid on the way as long as one kilo.
dialogue.en: After drinking up rice wine, laid on the way as long as one kilo.

dialogue.text: The Gumaas are finally reunited with their loved ones who they haven't seen for a year.
dialogue.zh: Gumaas終於與一年未見的親人團聚。
dialogue.ja: グマアスは一年ぶりに会う愛する人たちと再会します。
dialogue.local: The Gumaas are finally reunited with their loved ones who they haven't seen for a year.
dialogue.en: The Gumaas are finally reunited with their loved ones who they haven't seen for a year.

dialogue.text: Everyone gathers in the village square, dancing the Luzhang Hoftflower dance, making the
dialogue.zh: 大家聚集在村廣場，跳魯章荷花舞，製作
dialogue.ja: みんなが村の広場に集まり、ルザン・ホフトフラワーの踊りを踊り、作っています。
dialogue.local: Everyone gathers in the village square, dancing the Luzhang Hoftflower dance, making the
dialogue.en: Everyone gathers in the village square, dancing the Luzhang Hoftflower dance, making the

dialogue.text: silver rice cakes, eating at long tables, I've never seen anything quite like this
dialogue.zh: 銀米糕，在長桌上吃，我從未見過這樣的
dialogue.ja: 銀の米ケーキを作り、長いテーブルで食べます。こんな光景は見たことがありません。
dialogue.local: silver rice cakes, eating at long tables, I've never seen anything quite like this
dialogue.en: silver rice cakes, eating at long tables, I've never seen anything quite like this

dialogue.text: miao new year feast.
dialogue.zh: 苗族新年盛宴。
dialogue.ja: 苗族の新年の宴です。
dialogue.local: miao new year feast.
dialogue.en: miao new year feast.

dialogue.text: It may only be on this day that you will see such particular customs in New Year's
dialogue.zh: 可能只有在這一天你才能看到這樣特別的新年習俗，
dialogue.ja: この日だけに見られる特別な新年の習慣かもしれません。
dialogue.local: It may only be on this day that you will see such particular customs in New Year's
dialogue.en: It may only be on this day that you will see such particular customs in New Year's

dialogue.text: week.
dialogue.zh: 週。
dialogue.ja: 週です。
dialogue.local: week.
dialogue.en: week.

dialogue.text: The warmest of atmosphere and the most unique miao new year.
dialogue.zh: 最溫馨的氣氛和最獨特的苗族新年。
dialogue.ja: 最も温かい雰囲気と最もユニークな苗族の新年です。
dialogue.local: The warmest of atmosphere and the most unique miao new year.
dialogue.en: The warmest of atmosphere and the most unique miao new year.

dialogue.text: The 24 solar terms which were created in a distant past to guide the farmers of China have
dialogue.zh: 24節氣是遠古時代為指導中國農民而創造的，
dialogue.ja: 24節気は遠い昔に中国の農民を導くために作られましたが、
dialogue.local: The 24 solar terms which were created in a distant past to guide the farmers of China have
dialogue.en: The 24 solar terms which were created in a distant past to guide the farmers of China have

dialogue.text: turned out to affect every aspect of Chinese life.
dialogue.zh: 結果影響了中國生活的各個方面。
dialogue.ja: 中国の生活のあらゆる面に影響を与えています。
dialogue.local: turned out to affect every aspect of Chinese life.
dialogue.en: turned out to affect every aspect of Chinese life.

dialogue.text: Each solar term is implied in rich multi-led Chinese cultural events and traditions and holds
dialogue.zh: 每個節氣都蘊含著豐富多元的中國文化活動和傳統，並擁有
dialogue.ja: それぞれの節気は豊かで多様な中国の文化行事や伝統に含まれており、
dialogue.local: Each solar term is implied in rich multi-led Chinese cultural events and traditions and holds
dialogue.en: Each solar term is implied in rich multi-led Chinese cultural events and traditions and holds

dialogue.text: a wisdom that has been maintained with thousands of years.
dialogue.zh: 數千年來一直保持的智慧。
dialogue.ja: 何千年も受け継がれてきた知恵を持っています。
dialogue.local: a wisdom that has been maintained with thousands of years.
dialogue.en: a wisdom that has been maintained with thousands of years.
